directive: **Structure** — the features are a dependency DAG (`bsc-plan feature list` shows each feature + its `dependsOn`). SEQUENCE them into a roadmap, all IN THE PLAN DB — do NOT write phases.json or any issue files. Issues are generated from the features at GitHub-publish time, not during planning (no `bsc-plan add`). Two writes: (1) define the ordered phases — `bsc-plan phase add "<name>" "<done-when>"`, foundations first (`bsc-plan phase list` numbers them); (2) assign EVERY feature its phase NUMBER via `echo '{"slug":"…","phase":<n>}' | bsc-plan feature add` (merges in place). When every feature is phased, present the roadmap + the dependency graph and get the user's approval. (Existing repos: inventory every screen/module first so none is missed.)

require.label: sequence every feature into a phase

blurb: Sequence the feature DAG into phases — in the plan DB; issues are generated at publish, not here.
prompt:
The features are a dependency DAG — run `bsc-plan feature list` to see every feature and its
`dependsOn`. SEQUENCE them into a roadmap, all IN THE PLAN DB — do NOT write phases.json or any issue
files. Issues are generated from the features at GitHub-publish time, not during planning (no
`bsc-plan add`). Two writes:
1. Define the ordered **phases** — `bsc-plan phase add "<name>" "<done-when description>"`, foundations
   first (a feature's `dependsOn` features in the same or an earlier phase). `bsc-plan phase list` shows
   them numbered.
2. Assign EVERY feature its phase NUMBER (1-based, matching the phase order):
   `echo '{"slug":"sketcher","phase":2}' | bsc-plan feature add`  (merges in place — slug + phase only).
When every feature is phased, present the roadmap + the dependency graph and get the user's APPROVAL.
Leave no TODO / TBD / FIXME / XXX markers — the gate blocks on them.

Where a real cross-feature contract exists (a shared schema/types/API), write it as a doc under
`contracts/<name>.md` — the director owns those and workers read them as the source of truth.

substeps.label: Sequence features into phases
substeps.gate: every feature is phased in the DB
substeps.prompt:
Using the feature DAG (`bsc-plan feature list`), sequence the features into ordered phases
— foundations first, a feature's `dependsOn` features in the same or an earlier phase. Two DB writes:
(1) define the phases via `bsc-plan phase add "<name>" "<done-when>"` (in order); (2) assign EVERY
feature its phase number via `echo '{"slug":"…","phase":<n>}' | bsc-plan feature add` (merges in place).
Do NOT write phases.json or any issues — phases live in the DB, and issues are generated from the
features afterward, not in this stage. Present the roadmap + the dependency graph and get the user's APPROVAL.
